examples.html: A configured accent underline, a current-color underline, and a transparent underline.
examples.scaffoldCss:
.wind-demo-decoration { max-width: 34rem; color: #223247; border: 1px solid #b7c5d4; padding: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.8; }
.wind-demo-decoration a { color: inherit; }
